fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole SUV (2008 Lincoln MKX) in the cars by owner section.
findings: Wear and creasing on the driver seat bolster and cushion, light beige leather looks dingy
Smudges and marks on the back of the front passenger headrest and seatback

Item on the passenger floor near the console

message: Hi, we saw your listing for the white MKX. The light leather shows wear and some marks on the driver seat and the back of the headrests, and the front bumper and headlights look a bit dull in the photos. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including a leather clean, exterior polish and headlight restoration. Would you like a quote?
